interpretation: The distributed-memory mapping removed the prior compiler-memory combinational-loop blocker, and the compatibility map removed the RAM64X1S packing blocker. The unchanged integrated compiler accelerator plus PCIe/UberDDR3 composition reaches placement and active routing under the fixed profile, but this bounded router run did not converge. This is an implementation convergence frontier; it is not evidence of PCIe, DDR3, or accelerator functional failure.
